subject: is it possible to add an line with abline?

messages.author: 7a54d0c9bf7b3fed
messages.subject: is it possible to add an line with abline?
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm new to both R and mirt. I have tried to add a line with abline as follows:

> plot(gpcm, type = "SE")
> abline(h=.3)
Error in int_abline(a = a, b = b, h = h, v = v, untf = untf, ...) : 
  plot.new has not been called yet

Is there a way to add a line at the hight 0.3 in the figure?

Thank you.

Frank Bach

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: is it possible to add an line with abline?
parts:
mirt uses the lattice system of graphics (based on the grid package), so you'd have to use something like latticeExtra or gridExtra to add plots. See this thread: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/mirt-package/latticeExtra%7Csort:date/mirt-package/IqTPgi0g-W8/K6JRhObvAgAJ

Phil
